_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N351308 (2025-07-31, development Part 102 split; subject: "The country of origin of brake calipers"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held Mexico. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8708.30). Family: the family check (vehicle_parts, 0.95); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (0: none). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target United States by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for United States are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
